name: memory-conservatory
description: The Memory Conservatory — wedding photography. Static site: HTML, CSS, JS, Tailwind. Deployed on Netlify.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:gallery && npm run build:html
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n css,html,serve -c cyan,magenta,green "npm:watch:css" "npm:watch:html" "npm:serve"
